ku.text: A system can be solved graphically at intersections or numerically using a suitable calculator solver.
A polynomial root is an $x$-value for which $f(x)=0$.
Graph first to identify the number and approximate location of solutions; a numerical solver may return only one solution per starting value.

parts.label: Solution
parts.a: $(x-2)(x-3)=0$, so $x=2$ or $x=3$. Both give zero when substituted.
